walkthrough:
Calculate the square base area $A$ of the water surface with side length $\frac{1}{2}h\text{ cm}$:
$$A = \left(\frac{1}{2}h\right)^2 = \frac{1}{4}h^2$$

Substitute $A$ into the pyramid volume formula $V = \frac{1}{3}Ah$:
$$V = \frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{1}{4}h^2\right)h = \frac{1}{12}h^3$$

Differentiate the volume formula with respect to $h$:
$$\frac{dV}{dh} = \frac{d}{dh}\left(\frac{1}{12}h^3\right) = \frac{3}{12}h^2 = \frac{1}{4}h^2$$

Apply the chain rule for connected rates of change with $\frac{dV}{dt} = 20\text{ cm}^3\text{ min}^{-1}$:
$$\frac{dh}{dt} = \frac{dV}{dt} \div \frac{dV}{dh} = \frac{20}{\frac{1}{4}h^2} = \frac{80}{h^2}$$
